summary: Iteration 14 (frontend-only) — Real User Onboarding & Calendar UX validated end-to-end on the web preview. All 8 test areas PASS. STATE A (new user iter14.newuser.1785445956@example.com): calendar-hero card renders below Focus card with exact title 'Collega il tuo Google Calendar', subtitle 'ORA può capire automaticamente i tuoi impegni e aiutarti a organizzare la giornata.', and two CTAs — btn-connect-google labeled 'Continua con Google' and btn-how-it-works labeled 'Scopri come funziona'. DOM grep on Home confirmed ZERO occurrences of tech words 'OAuth', 'Connector', 'Token', 'Client ID', 'GOCSPX', 'redirect_uri', '403', '404', 'state expired'. btn-how-it-works navigates to /how-it-works showing testID how-it-works with 4 steps (Collega il tuo calendario · Capiamo la tua giornata · Ti diciamo cosa fare adesso · I tuoi dati restano tuoi) each with an icon (calendar/sparkles/flag/shield) plus btn-back-home CTA. btn-connect-google triggers a real request to /api/connectors/google-calendar/oauth/start and then window.location.assign(authorize_url) to accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth (verified via request interception, external redirect blocked in test). STATE C (demo@ora.app): Home correctly hides calendar-hero AND calendar-connected-nosync AND calendar-connected-synced; daily-card + focus-card both render. All iter12 regression testIDs still present (focus-card, daily-card, why-now-btn, btn-start, btn-complete, btn-partial, btn-postpone, btn-more, btn-daily-detail) with their sheets (sheet-why, sheet-confirm, sheet-partial, sheet-postpone, sheet-more, sheet-daily) opening on tap and Italian labels intact. offline-banner correctly appears on navigator.onLine=false + window.dispatchEvent('offline'). Settings screen (/settings) loads with testID settings + settings-connection showing account email francesconicolocefala@gmail.com · badge 'Collegato' · meta grid 'ULTIMA SINCRONIZZAZIONE 40 min fa' / 'CALENDARI 1' / 'EVENTI OGGI 0' plus 3 CTA buttons (btn-settings-sync, btn-settings-manage, btn-revoke). btn-settings-manage navigates to /manage-calendars?instance=ci_5a58fde78638416b (real demo connector id) with testID manage-calendars rendering 2 calendars (Festività in Italia + francesconicolocefala@gmail.com marked 'Principale', cal-row-0 present); toggling cal-row-0 flips btn-save-calendars from aria-disabled=true/opacity=0.6 to aria-disabled=null/opacity=1 — Save enable/disable logic works. btn-revoke opens confirm-revoke dialog with exact title 'Vuoi davvero disconnettere Google Calendar?' + body 'ORA smetterà di ricevere i tuoi eventi. Potrai ricollegarlo quando vuoi.' + two buttons (Annulla / Disconnetti); Annulla closes the dialog without revoking. Responsive: mobile (390x844) shows Focus+Daily+Dopo without overflow; desktop (1280x900) centers content around ~720px width; tablet (768x1024) layout OK. Dark background verified on Home, /settings, /how-it-works, /manage-calendars (all use tokens.color.surface #000000). Touch target: btn-start = 84x44px (meets 44px min). Zero console errors and zero pageerrors across all flows.

issues: Meta grid labels rendered UPPERCASE via textTransform (ULTIMA SINCRONIZZAZIONE / CALENDARI / EVENTI OGGI) — consistent with iter12 pattern and matches design intent; noting for awareness only, not a defect.

critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx refactored from 1155 lines (iter12) to 346 lines (~350 target) — well within the 700-line guideline. Orchestrator cleanly imports HomeHeader/FocusNowCard/DailySummaryCard/LaterList/EmptyFocus/CalendarConnectionCard + DecisionSheets. Good split.

CalendarConnectionCard renders correctly for all 3 states (A: heroCard, B: card+syncNow, C: card+stats+actions). Home orchestrator computes showCalendarCard = !instance || !instance.last_sync_at (index.tsx:204) so State C is hidden on Home in favor of DailySummary and only reachable from /settings — matches spec.

btn-connect-google (CalendarConnectionCard.tsx:120-128) shows loading label 'Apro Google…' while POST /api/connectors/google-calendar/oauth/start is in flight, then window.location.assign(authorize_url) on web — verified with request interception; no crash.

settings.tsx uses a Modal-style confirm-revoke overlay with two clear ActionBtns (Annulla / Disconnetti). Annulla closes without side effects — safe to test the demo user without accidentally revoking.
manage-calendars.tsx computes 'dirty' state (btn-save-calendars) by comparing selectedIds to initialSelectedIds; opacity + aria-disabled correctly reflect it. Good UX.
how-it-works.tsx is a static 4-step onboarding screen with well-chosen icons (calendar-outline / sparkles-outline / flag-outline / shield-checkmark-outline) — matches brand.
All new interactive elements have testID + accessibilityRole='button' + hitSlop or minHeight >=44px. Accessibility compliance is maintained.
Zero tech vocabulary ('OAuth', 'Connector', 'Token', 'Client ID') visible on Home DOM for either State A or State C — matches the 'human, non-technical UX' requirement.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 8 requested test areas PASS (State A hero + how-it-works nav + connect flow, State C hidden card + DailySummary present, /settings full flow with meta grid + 3 CTAs, /manage-calendars checkbox+save logic, confirm-revoke dialog, iter12 regression on all sheets + offline banner, responsive across mobile/tablet/desktop + dark surface, zero console errors).

seed_data_creation: One temporary user registered via UI (iter14.newuser.1785445956@example.com / Test!Probe!2026) to exercise STATE A. No data mutations on demo user (btn-revoke dialog was opened then Annulla-cancelled; cal-row-0 was toggled off then toggled back to original state before leaving manage-calendars; no Save was pressed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 14 calendar UX is production-ready on web preview. To reproduce State A: register new user via 'Continua con Email' → 'Nuovo? Crea un account' → home renders Focus card + calendar-hero directly below. To reproduce State C: login demo@ora.app / Demo!2026 → home shows only Focus+Daily+Later (no calendar card). To exercise /settings and /manage-calendars: from Profile tab click profile-row-settings OR navigate directly to http://localhost:3000/settings (direct URL nav works reliably; profile row click sometimes needs an extra 500ms wait in Playwright). btn-revoke opens confirm-revoke overlay — always click 'Annulla' when testing demo user; NEVER click 'Disconnetti' since the demo connector is a real Google Calendar link (ci_5a58fde78638416b, francesconicolocefala@gmail.com, 1 calendar synced, 0 events today). State B (connected but never synced) was NOT UI-testable because the real OAuth callback flow is external and cannot be automated; the code path renders calendar-connected-nosync + btn-sync-now correctly — verified by code inspection only. If a future iteration needs a State B fixture, seed a ConnectorInstance for the demo user with last_sync_at=null via a backend script.
